description: Type-safe Node.js environment validation with validateEnv. npm: env-core; JSR: @nec/env-core. Primitive schemas, structured failures and synchronous validation.
rules: npm env-core and JSR @nec/env-core expose validateEnv. Use the installed release's documentation; loadEnv, generateEnvExample and CLI commands require 1.3.0 or later.
An explicit configuration object passed to validateEnv is the sole source. Validation never modifies process.env.

In v2, validateEnv without config uses only process.env; use loadEnv for files. In v1, omitted config also reads optional .env. loadEnv layers later files over earlier files; process wins unless override: true.
Numbers are strict by default in v2; strict: false retains legacy coercion. In v1, strict numbers are opt-in. Booleans always accept only typed booleans or exact true/false strings.
Validation callbacks are synchronous and run after built-in checks. Defaults are checked too; missing optional fields skip callbacks.
Report issue codes and keys without values or custom messages. sensitive: true suppresses custom error messages; successful values are unchanged.
CLI JavaScript schemas work on Node 16+. Direct TypeScript schemas require Node 22.18+ native type stripping and erasable syntax. Use repeated --file flags for layers.
